documents.description: Search rulemaking documents (proposed rules, rules, notices, supporting material) across agencies. At most 10,000 per query.

filter[agencyId].desc: agency acronym, e.g. EPA, FDA, OSHA, CMS, FAA (comma-separated for several)

filter[documentType].desc: Proposed Rule | Rule | Notice | Supporting & Related Material | Other

filter[commentEndDate][ge].desc: comment period ends on or after YYYY-MM-DD

filter[commentEndDate][le].desc: comment period ends on or before YYYY-MM-DD

filter[lastModifiedDate][ge].desc: modified on or after 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (Eastern time); use to page past 10,000

document.description: One document's full metadata (CFR part, FR citation, page count, comment dates, file links).

comments.description: Search posted public comments (id, title, posted date). At most 10,000 per query; the text needs the 'comment' endpoint per comment.

filter[docketId].desc: docket id: every comment in the docket

filter[commentOnId].desc: objectId of a document (from 'documents' or 'document', e.g. 0900006485a3507a): comments on that document

filter[lastModifiedDate][ge].desc: modified on or after 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (Eastern time); use to page past 10,000

sort.desc: postedDate | -postedDate | lastModifiedDate (use with filter[lastModifiedDate][ge] to page past 10,000) | documentId

comment_count.description: Number of posted comments matching the filters (one row: totalElements), without downloading them.

filter[lastModifiedDate][ge].desc: modified on or after 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (Eastern time); use to page past 10,000

comment.description: One comment: text (attributes.comment), submitter fields as posted, organization, attachments.

dockets.description: Search dockets (rulemaking and nonrulemaking folders). At most 10,000 per query.

docket.description: One docket: title, RIN, abstract, keywords, program, type.

public_comments.name: Public comments
public_comments.description: comments on a docket (filter[docketId]) or a document (filter[commentOnId] = objectId)

comment_totals.name: Comment counts
comment_totals.description: how many comments a docket or document received (posted)

agency_ids.id: EPA; FDA; CMS; OSHA; FAA; NHTSA; DOT; USDA; FWS; NOAA; CFPB; DOE; ED; HHS; IRS
agency_ids.name: Agency acronyms
agency_ids.description: values for filter[agencyId]; some independent agencies (SEC, FCC, FERC) run their own comment systems
